title: Lab - Schedule tasks
description: Run jobs on a schedule with cron, at and a systemd timer.
scenario: Run jobs on a schedule with cron, at and a systemd timer. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own VM and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# Any Linux VM with sudo will do - Ubuntu 22.04 or Rocky 9, 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM.
# Snapshot it before you start so a broken task is a revert away.
sudo -i
hostnamectl
cleanup: # Revert the VM snapshot, or undo the changes you made by hand.

tasks.title: Task 1 - cron
tasks.instructions: Run the disk report every weekday at 07:30 from the root crontab.

tasks.title: Task 2 - at
tasks.instructions: Schedule a one-off job 5 minutes from now that touches /tmp/at-ran.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Timer
tasks.instructions: Create diskreport.timer that fires daily and enable it.
tasks.solution:
# [Timer] OnCalendar=daily Persistent=true; [Install] WantedBy=timers.target
systemctl enable --now diskreport.timer
